description: Purple UI component registry - enumerate all components and foundations without reading every spec file. (This field previously held this sentence in $schema itself, which is not a valid URI - the single most MCP-hostile thing in the repo per the mobile-parity audit. $schema now points at a real schema file; this text moved here.)

components.name: PUTextInput
components.notes: iOS and Android are not yet built - see the spec's implementation block. Claimed in `platforms` as the target contract, not current reality.

components.name: PUToggle
components.notes: Spec only - no PurpleUI toggle/switch implementation exists yet on any platform. Contract for a follow-up build. docPage is null (not the old dead link "/inputs/toggle") - no doc page exists until there's something to document.

components.name: PUWalletStack
components.notes: Self-contained Apple Wallet stack container. Uses PUPassCard internally.

components.name: PU3DPassCard
components.notes: WebGL 3D render of the Purple WiFi Pass. Client-side only, zero SSR impact.

reactNative.status: first slice - theme tokens + PUButton, PUIconButton, PUToast. Remaining components (PUFloatingButton, PUBottomTray, PUValidationModal, PULoader, PUSearchBar, PUBottomNav) not yet ported.

snapshots.requires: npm run dev  # dev server must be running on port 3000

excludedComponents.name: PUInfoCard
excludedComponents.reason: Not wired into any doc page or other component in this repo - no consumer at all. Hardcodes several colours (#0d7a49, #7a6a00, #a01e28, #1e40af, and a bare `text-gray-700` Tailwind utility) that are not Purple tokens - inconsistent with tokens.json and every other registered component. Treat as an unmaintained prototype, not a design-system component, unless/until someone actively adopts and retokenizes it.

excludedComponents.name: PUStatCard
excludedComponents.reason: Not referenced by any doc page or other component in this repo - appears to be a dashboard/KPI-tile experiment that was never adopted. Has no dark-mode handling at all. Excluded from the spec registry until there is a real consumer to spec against.

excludedComponents.name: PUListRow
excludedComponents.reason: Corrected after review: initially registered with specs/PUListRow.json on the claim that it 'backs a real in-use surface (PUBottomTray's doc example)'. That claim was checked and is false - src/components/ui/PUListRow.tsx is never imported or rendered anywhere. The bottom-tray doc page renders its venue list with hand-rolled divs; the only occurrences of the string "PUListRow" are inside that page's traySwiftCode/trayKotlinCode template-literal sample text (illustrative Swift/Kotlin, not real web output, and for platforms this component was never spec'd for - platforms was ["web"] only). By the same no-real-consumer test applied to PUInfoCard/PUStatCard above, PUListRow is excluded too. specs/PUListRow.json was removed. Re-register if a real consumer appears.
